pages.content:
The severed spectral skull of an Eternal Guardian, claimed after defeating one in close combat. Pale soulfire still flickers within its hollow eye sockets.

§6Acquisition & Use§r
Guaranteed drop when an Eternal Guardian is slain with melee attacks. While unwearable on its own, fastening leather straps to both sides at a crafting table yields the §5Eternal Guardian Mask§r.
